detail: 3 successful sols demonstrated. Earth confirmed the evidence; +6 grant parts, 2-part bond returned, +6 Fame. Sheltering stops production. Stored supplies keep the crew going. Curiosity measured 8,100 micrograys during the May 20, 2024 event on Mars; our shelter capacities are game numbers, not dose predictions.
